verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Functions can be triggered by HTTP requests and SDK methods, as well as events, webhooks and schedules [appwrite-docs-9]. They run in secure, isolated runtimes that scale with demand, with 13+ runtimes supported [appwrite-docs-64, appwrite-docs-48]. Functions can be deployed via the CLI, including headless CI use [appwrite-docs-12, appwrite-docs-42]. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of function deployment and invocation, and scaling documentation (one community user said they could not find docs on how cloud functions scale [appwrite-comm-10]).
